title: Chiquitano languages - Wikipedia
text: Chiquitano (or Tarapecosi) is a group of linguistic varieties, thought to belong to the Macro-Jê languages, spoken in the central region of Santa Cruz Department of eastern Bolivia and the state of Mato Grosso in Brazil. Chiquitano is usually considered to be a language isolate.

title: Chiquitano - Wikipedia
text: The Chiquitano or Chiquitos are an Indigenous people of Bolivia, with a small number also living in Brazil. The Chiquitano primarily live in the Chiquitania tropical savanna of Santa Cruz Department, Bolivia, with a small number also living in Beni Department and in Mato Grosso, Brazil.

title: Musical instruments of the Chiquitano people - aacademica.org
text: Chiquitano musical ensembles are divided into two major groups: the church's capilla musical ("musical cha-pel"), derived from the Jesuit musical ensembles, which play liturgical music, and the traditional ensembles fea-turing flutes and drums.
